name: threadline-first-task
description: Review current Threadline first-task evidence and prepare unapproved local next steps with human decisions in the existing webpage.

interface.shortDescription: Check sources and prepare a first-task proposal
interface.longDescription: Local companion for one explicitly configured existing Threadline workspace. Reads current evidence or saves an unapproved plan. Human confirmation and task approval stay in the webpage.
defaultPrompt: Review my Threadline first task and show what needs my decision.
